review_locator: PMCID:PMC5520377, New insights into Blimp-1 in T lymphocytes: a divergent regulator of cell destiny and effector function
primary_title: Role of Blimp-1 in programing Th effector cells into IL-10 producers
decision_basis: The review identifies Blimp-1 as a direct regulator of Il10 in effector T cells; the cited primary demonstrates Blimp-1 binding at the Il10 CNS-9 regulatory element, loss-of-function reduction and ectopic-expression enhancement of Il10 expression in Th1 cells, with inflammatory infection function.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the direct Blimp-1-associated Il10 gene-regulation bridge in mouse Th1/effector-T-cell contexts. Preserve the IL-12/STAT4 induction context, CNS-9 regulatory element and c-Maf cooperation; Il10 transcription does not by itself prove IL-10 secretion, IL10R signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC5520377, New insights into Blimp-1 in T lymphocytes: a divergent regulator of cell destiny and effector function
primary_title: Blimp-1 directly represses Il2 and the Il2 activator Fos, attenuating T cell proliferation and survival
decision_basis: The review identifies Blimp-1 as a direct repressor of Il2 in activated T cells; the cited primary demonstrates Blimp-1 binding at an Il2 regulatory region, increased Il2 mRNA/protein after Prdm1 loss and reduced IL-2 with Blimp-1 expression, supporting an IL-2-to-Blimp-1 negative-feedback loop.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the direct Blimp-1-associated Il2 gene-repression bridge in activated mouse T cells. Preserve the activation-time and autoregulatory-loop context; do not infer universal T-cell suppression, IL-2 protein/IL2R signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.
